Wrenwell is an approved account based in Ireland, operating on Europe/Dublin timezone.

Financial services allow targeting in Ireland and the UK with no special restrictions. Age targeting will be set to 18+ since sole traders are typically adults. The campaign will focus on iOS and Android platforms only.

The campaign objective is WEBSITE_CLICKS with LINK_CLICKS as the goal. This proxies app installs since X cannot track them directly. The total budget is 350 USD, though the account may use EUR.

The campaign will run from January 16 to January 28, 2027. That is a 12-day flight. The daily budget should be roughly $29.17 if the account bills in USD.

The total budget will be set to 350 USD across all line items, with daily budgets pacing evenly to prevent overspending. The strategy is to promote all three posts initially for testing, then shift budget toward the highest-performing ad group. One campaign will contain three ad groups, one for each post, split equally at first.

The product explanation post is the strongest for cold traffic. The draft-invoices hook is shorter and curiosity-driven. The price post offers €0 for three months. Posts that clearly explain the product and include the price will likely convert better than the curiosity post.

A single ad group containing all three posts would let X optimize between them automatically. The user explicitly wants multiple campaigns and ad groups so they can pause or stop as they learn. Splitting by country is possible because the pricing differs between €7 in Ireland and £6 in the UK, but that would thin the budget too much for a $350 campaign.

Each ad group will receive roughly $9.70 daily, which sits comfortably above X’s typical minimum of about $1. English will be the target language, and mobile-only targeting is selected because the landing page is app-only. The next step is to verify platform IDs, age ranges, funding instruments, and whether the three posts are promotable.
